The '''vibrosword''' was a longer, heavier version of the [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]].

==Description==
The vibrosword was based on [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] weapon design.<ref name="KOTOR 2 Prima Official Guide" /> It was generally wielded with two [[hand]]s, although some beings were strong enough to wield them with one and carry two of them.

The vibrosword model that was commonly used around [[3956 BBY]] during the [[Old Republic era]] contained [[cortosis-weave]],<ref name="KOTOR 2 Prima Official Guide" /> granting it lightsaber-deflecting abilities which made it more effective against the numerous lightsaber-wielding opponents during that era. The vibrosword model used during the [[Rise of the Empire era]] did not contain this cortosis enhancement.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" />

Variants of the vibrosword included the icy [[Echani vibrosword]] and the high-tech [[Baragwin assault blade]].

==History==
[[File:HalfedCommandoDroid.png|thumb|left|250px|A vibrosword used by a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]]]]The vibrosword was used by members of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]], such as security chief [[Souske]],<ref name="Fate of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Fate of the Jedi|the ''Oppressor''}}</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Marcovic]],<ref name="New Intelligence">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|New Intelligence|Ord Mantell}}</ref> and [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] warrior [[Khem Val]]. The weapon was also used by [[Keshk]], a [[Grand Chieftain]] of the [[Flesh Raider]]s.<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Weapon of the Jedi|Tython}}</ref>

During the Rise of the Empire era, vibroswords were used by [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] and seemed effective against [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. But they were also effective against droids, as [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] used one against battle droids when he fought alongside [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and several other Jedi younglings on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] invaded the planet. The weapons were also used by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] scavengers.<ref name="Clone Wars Miniatures Preview 3">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/CloneWarspreview3|text=''Clone Wars'' Miniatures Preview 3}}</ref> [[Sapphire (smuggler)|Sapphire]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operative and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], carried a vibrosword with her.<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>

During the [[Legacy era]], the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]'s elite [[Venom assault squad]]s used vibroswords during boarding raids and other close-quarters combat situations.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide" />
